rationale: The reviewer identified that SelectKBest ran on all 60 samples before CV and showed that the leaky procedure scores about 0.99 even on shuffled labels. They measured the nested-CV AUROC at 0.583 (one seed, about 0.51 averaged), which matches the key's ~0.58, and recommended nested selection or a held-out cohort. Their other points are generic caveats, not separate substantive flaws.
